feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 2:07am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W or W-NW 3 or less, soon backing SW or Southerly 2 to 4, then SE 5 or 6 during the evening. Veering Southerly 4 at the end of the night.


##State of sea)##

Slight, falling smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Mostly fair, then rain arriving overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in the rain overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

South or SW 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5, then 6 or 7 for a while later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Patchy rain at first, soon mostly fair but some mist & a risk of fog patches, then rain overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in rain or mist, very poor in any fog.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tuesday, 13 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at times.


##Wind)##

SW 4 or 5, imminently veering W or SW 3 or 4, increasing 5 to 7 late afternoon & evening, backing S-SW 6 or 7 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough at first, becoming slight or moderate, then moderate or rough again overnight.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain at first, soon fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Wednesday, 14 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong or gale force winds.


##Wind)##

S-SW 6 or 7, increasing 7 or gale 8.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough.


##Weather)##

Mostly fair, then rain overnight.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good, becoming moderate or poor overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Thursday, 15 October 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind.


##Wind)##

S-SW 6 or 7, veering NW 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain soon developing, clearing later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
